scientific_integrity: A complete closed-form backward-equation proof and an executable finite-difference/symbolic checker are supplied. Experiments corroborate but do not certify continuum claims. No independent audit or experimental validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time one-dimensional Brownian model with a point target and position-only Poisson resets; no finite-width, drifted, partially absorbing or gate-reset cases are claimed.
The limits of strictly positive parameters do not directly certify dynamics at exactly zero rates.

The primary source qualitatively narrates a switching-speed trend for simulated hit-side fractions that has not been reconciled with the exact continuum directional law; no simulation correction is asserted.
Published-priority search is non-exhaustive; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact opposite-side absorption law for a transparent blinking Brownian target under resetting
